# Mohamed Tahiri

> Software engineer based in Miami. I build AI systems that hold up in production: agents with real tools, hybrid search, evaluation, and the products around them. Currently an AI engineer at Barfield (Air France-KLM group). Trained at UTC Compiègne, France.

The site is available in English and French, with the home page also in German, Japanese, Korean and Arabic. Case studies and articles are written in English and French.

## Work

- [Buddy](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/projects/buddy): an AI agent in production for maintenance teams, with hybrid search, tools, sourced answers and continuous evaluation.
- [Agent entrepreneur](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/projects/agent-entrepreneur): an experiment where an AI agent runs a small online business, with a human approving every spend.
- [Barfield Studio](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/projects/barfield-studio): a Claude Code plugin that lets non-technical teams produce videos and trainings.
- [Course platform](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/projects/plateforme-de-cours): web and native apps, over 1,000 commits, infrastructure fully as code.
- [Open-source SDKs](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/projects/sdk-open-source): typed Python and TypeScript libraries generated from an OpenAPI spec checked in CI, plus a Home Assistant integration.

## Writing

- [Hybrid search, explained by playing with it](https://mohamedtahiri.com/en/blog/recherche-hybride): why embeddings alone miss obvious answers, and how BM25, reciprocal rank fusion and reranking fix it. Includes interactive simulations.
